data.one_liner: Extension methods to get the week number and ordinal date from a DateTime object.
data.what_it_does: Adds fast, dependency-free extension methods to Dart's DateTime object to compute ISO 8601 or Western Traditional week numbers. It also provides functions to create DateTime objects from year and week numbers or ordinal dates.
use_when: You need to calculate ISO 8601 or Western Traditional week numbers from DateTime objects.
You want to convert ordinal dates or week numbers back into DateTime instances.
avoid_when: You need heavy internationalization or full calendar localization beyond standard week systems.
strengths: Supports both ISO 8601 and Western Traditional systems
Includes helper functions for ordinal dates and leap years
weaknesses: Very narrow scope focused only on week numbers and ordinal dates
